name: Yeneen
sum: Yeneen is a titanosaur from the Santonian Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Argentina, known from at least one partial skeleton.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: MAU-Pv-LI-538, a partial skeleton; an ilium (MAU-Pv-LI-539) and a third specimen (MAU-Pv-LI-731) are associated.
material: Three specimens from the Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
biology: Its anatomy mimics that of a rebbachisaurid.
author: Filippi et al. 2026

images.caption: Life restoration of Yeneen houssayi in side view.
